scripts.codegen: mkdir -p src/__generated__ && ([ -f src/__generated__/persisted-queries.json ] || echo '{}' > src/__generated__/persisted-queries.json) && relay-compiler
scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist/server && node scripts/ngroutes.ts > dist/ngroutes.json && node scripts/precompress.ts
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development API_URL=http://x-ssr-api.localhost:3355 nsl run --name x-ssr node --watch-path=server --watch-path=../../packages server/main.ts
